reporter.title: PRINCIPLES: Synthetic Strategy Memory for Proactive Dialogue Agents

rows.notes: Self-play simulation: an LLM user simulator and an LLM critic (both gpt-4o, §3.3) play out each test episode for up to 10 turns; the critic's verbal verdict is sampled 10 times (temperature 1.0), mapped to [-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1] and averaged, and an episode succeeds when the mean exceeds 0.5 (App. F.1). Score = success rate x 100. Agent replies without explicit strategy planning; the row label '+ GPT-3.5-Turbo' is read as the agent backbone. Average turns 8.59. The paper reimplements the baselines with its own prompts (App. F.2) but does not say explicitly whether any number was copied.
